name: @veilio-inc/engine
description: Two-way code anonymizer: replace real identifiers with __P1__ tokens before sending source code to an LLM, restore them afterward. Pure, local, no network, no telemetry, zero runtime dependencies.
author: Veilio

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test

//version: The published version, kept in step by hand. semantic-release computes the next version from the engine-v tags and @semantic-release/npm writes it into the tarball at publish time; since @semantic-release/git was removed the bump is never committed back, so this field drifts unless somebody moves it. It has to be right now that packages/cli and packages/mcp resolve the engine as a workspace: if this is below their declared range, npm silently installs a REGISTRY copy beside the source and both tools get tested against a different engine than the one in the tree.
